title: Intro to Machine Learning Workshop
description: Basics.

title: Data Science Study Group
description: Weekly study group for students in the Data Science and Statistics courses. Covers problem sets, project ideas, and exam revision together.

title: Spring Career Fair 2025
description: Meet recruiters from over 50 companies. Bring printed CVs and dress professionally. Open to all years. Sectors include tech, finance, healthcare, and engineering.

title: Resume & LinkedIn Review Clinic
description: One-to-one sessions with careers advisors to review your CV, cover letters, and LinkedIn profile. Book your slot in advance through the student portal.

title: Interfaculty Basketball Tournament
description: Annual interfaculty basketball tournament. Register your team of 5 by March 15th. Trophies and prizes for winners. All skill levels welcome.

title: 5K Campus Fun Run
description: Annual charity fun run around campus. All fitness levels welcome. Entry fee goes to the student hardship fund. T-shirts for the first 100 registrants.

title: Acoustic Open Mic Night
description: Share your music! Sign up to perform a 10-minute acoustic set. All genres welcome — folk, classical, original songs, covers. Great atmosphere guaranteed.

title: International Food Festival
description: Celebrate global cuisine! Student societies cook dishes from their home countries. Free tasting, cultural performances, and a recipe booklet to take home.

title: Web Development Hackathon
description: 24-hour hackathon building web apps around the theme of campus sustainability. Solo or teams of up to 4. Prizes include cloud credits and internship interviews.

title: Cybersecurity Capture the Flag
description: Beginner-friendly CTF competition covering cryptography, reverse engineering, and network security. Teams of 2–3. Winners invited to regional CTF league.

title: Mental Health & Mindfulness Session
description: Guided mindfulness and breathing exercises led by campus counsellors. Learn techniques to manage exam stress. No experience necessary. Drop in any time.

title: Yoga & Stretching Morning Class
description: Early morning yoga class suitable for all levels. Mats provided. Focus on flexibility, breathing, and starting the day with calm energy. Free for students.

title: Startup Pitch Competition
description: Pitch your startup idea to a panel of investors and entrepreneurs. Finalists win seed funding and mentorship. Open to all students. Submit abstracts by April 1st.

title: Photography Society Exhibition
description: Annual end-of-year exhibition of student photography. Themes include urban life, nature, and campus portraiture. Free entry, wine reception, and voting for People's Choice.

title: Student Film Screening Night
description: Screenings of short films made by student filmmakers this semester. Followed by Q&A with directors. Popcorn provided. Genres include documentary, animation, and drama.

title: Natural Language Processing Seminar
description: Guest lecture on modern NLP techniques including transformers, tokenisation, and large language models. Suitable for students with basic Python and ML background.

title: Swimming Gala
description: Competitive swimming event across multiple distances and strokes. Students can enter up to two events. Registration required. Timing chips provided on the day.

title: Board Game & Puzzle Social
description: Relaxed afternoon of board games, card games, and puzzles. All welcome. Games provided but feel free to bring your favourites. Great way to unwind and meet people.

title: Entrepreneurship Panel: Founders in Residence
description: Three alumni founders share their startup journeys, challenges, and advice for student entrepreneurs. Q&A session and networking drinks afterwards.

title: Choir & Orchestra Spring Concert
description: The campus choir and orchestra perform a programme of classical and contemporary pieces. Tickets available from the Student Union box office. Formal dress encouraged.
